Weekday an update for people travelling soon
With that in mind
Travelers, read this now for companion animal checks.

Aurelia Skyways is updating handling steps at the Companion Animal Travel Desk, and travelers with pets must review their papers before arrival. Our handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and the passenger coordinator is checking each file against the travel plan. <<FACT F079>> Bring every required form to the desk so staff can confirm the details and record any service change in the ledger.

If you are moving with a pet, stay in contact with the desk before you set out. Keep the carrier ready, keep the animal secure, and follow crew direction at the airport without delay. The department is sharing practical instructions with crews now, so early contact will help prevent a hold. For immediate support, go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
